h: Seven Books of Torah and Wisdom Born in Exile

p: It is stated in the Midrash
(וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה רֵישׁ פָּרָשַׁת שְׁמִינִי, יא, ג)
"'She has hewn out her seven pillars' (Mishlei 9:1):
these are the seven books of the Torah.
until 'And it was, when the Ark journeyed' one;
from 'And it was' until 'And when it rested' one;
"'She has hewn out her seven pillars':
these are the seven days of Creation."
וּבְוַדַּאי הַכֹּל הוֹלֵךְ אֶל מָקוֹם אֶחָד
Certainly it all goes to one place;
corresponds to the seven holy attributes,
is the three attributes of the holy Avos,
to flow into the seventh attribute,
the aspect of the revelation of the kingship of Heaven.
Now one can say in detail,
regarding the seven books of the Torah,
הוּא נֶגֶד בְּחִינַת אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to the aspect of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him;
for the whole book of Bereishis
speaks of the holiness of Bereishis,
"and he was placed in a coffin in Egypt";
for with this the holiness of Creation was completed
And this is the essence of the holiness of
Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
who stirred up in his heart
וְהִקְרִיא שְׁמוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
and caused the Name of HaKadosh Baruch Hu to be called
in the mouth of all people,
"And he called there in the Name of Hashem, God of the world."
And in the Midrash Rabbah (Bereishis Rabbah 3:5):
corresponding to the five books of the Torah:
corresponds to the book of Bereishis";
וְהוּא כְּנֶגֶד אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and it corresponds to Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
"'Let there be light': this is Avraham";
the two thousand years of Torah;
and he learned the entire Torah
from the creation of the world,
as Chazal, of blessed memory, said (Eruvin 100b):
not to steal from the ant,
of the actual giving of the Torah,
הוּא נֶגֶד בְּחִינַת יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to the aspect of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
the aspect of Gevurah and holy constriction;
for "the Torah came forth from Gevurah"
And corresponding to it is the utterance
this is the book of Shemos,
"'And there was light': this is Rosh HaShanah";
and in the Tikkunim (beginning of Tikkun 41):
that is, Gevurah, "the Dread of Yitzchak";
meaning, not to make a stir in the world
but only to those who belong to words of Torah,
and who are of the root of holiness.
הוּא נֶגֶד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
and as Chazal, of blessed memory, said
וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאוֹר כִּי טוֹב
"'And God saw the light, that it was good':
this is the book of Vayikra,"
which is full of many halachos;
that is, in it is clarified
And it is called the book of Toras Kohanim,
"For the lips of the Kohen guard knowledge";
and Yaakov is in the secret of Da'as
which Moshe said on his own,
into which all the attributes of the Written Torah
and it corresponds to the attribute of Malchus.
And the book of "And it was, when the Ark journeyed,"
which divides the book of Bamidbar in two
and they correspond to the aspect of Moshe and Aharon:
up to "And it was, when the Ark journeyed"
corresponds to Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
that he would bring them into Eretz Yisrael.
"And the Ark of the covenant of Hashem journeyed before them
to seek out a resting place for them";
the attributes of the holy Avos,
which stand against the three kelipos,
"to seek out a resting place for them":
וְהָיָה מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם סָבוּר
And Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him, thought
he would be the attribute of the fourth day,
and would bring Yisrael into Eretz Yisrael,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רמו, ב)
Shiloh has the gematria of Moshe.
אַךְ אַחַר כָּךְ כְּתִיב (בְּמִדְבַּר י, לג)
"And they journeyed from the mountain of Hashem
like a child running away from school;
of the giving of the Torah was hidden.
that he would not enter Eretz Yisrael;
and the appointment of the elders,
and the decree of the spies;
and Yehoshua would bring Yisrael into the land.
And this corresponds to the attribute of Hod,
"the counted ones who came to the land,"
הַיְינוּ חֵלֶק כָּל אֶחָד בְּאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל
that is, each one's portion in Eretz Yisrael
is the aspect of his own Torah she'b'al peh.
And Yehoshua is the one who apportions
And therefore he wrote the book of Yehoshua,
which is "the arrangement of Eretz Yisrael"
that is, all the words of Torah
And the book of "And it was, when the Ark journeyed" itself
corresponds to the aspect of Yosef HaTzaddik,
וְהַיְינוּ כִּי וַיְהִי בִּנְסוֹעַ הָאָרוֹן וְגוֹ׳
That is, "And it was, when the Ark journeyed…"
and this precisely is the foundation
for there to be increased and built through it
the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh;
as Chazal, of blessed memory, said (Menachos 99b):
And so it was immediately in the exile of Bavel,
where the Torah she'b'al peh was founded
And as stated in the Tanchuma (Noach 3)
"For in much wisdom is much anger";
came the increase of the wisdom
through exile and hardship and suffering,
aspects of renewal of Torah she'b'al peh
until through this we will merit
